title: Choose the visual world
question: Bolder hand dealt. The type specimen leads by deal order; the quilt wins on both axes. Keep, pick an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ejes (Variable Specimen)
options.thesis: The site as a live type specimen whose axis sliders drive the whole grid — and BIO³ is literally three axes, so the sliders are Bioinformática, Bioestadística and Biomatemáticas.
options.viewport: A giant BIO³ setting the page's scale, three axis sliders beneath it morphing every glyph and content cell in real time, with a monospace readout of axis values.
options.risk: Long member bios do not fit a glyph grid; without the three-axis idea it is a designer toy on a research group's page.

raised.raise: Dates as fixed-slot tabular readouts: unlit ghost cells behind every figure, seminar times never reflow.
A block-stepped progress bar showing how far the current seminar trimester has advanced.

options.label: Atlas de Retallos
options.thesis: Every member is a block with body, date and history — a provenance atlas where bios are captions stitched to their fabric.
options.viewport: A block grid of unequal patches opening the group statement, each member a labelled block, seminars as dated seams running through it.
options.risk: Handmade warmth can soften the scientific register if the cloth texture gets literal.
options.case: Beats the specimen on both axes: people and provenance are what this audience came for, and patch captions carry bios where a glyph grid cannot.

options.label: Manual de Montaje
options.thesis: The group's work as numbered exploded steps: parts inventory up front, each method shown as a sequence that clicks together.
options.viewport: Oversized step numerals, wordless arrows, a 1:1 call-out box introducing each discipline.
options.risk: Toy register can undercut institutional seriousness.
options.case: Holds product clarity — numbered steps carry mission and method beautifully; loses on audience identification for peers evaluating rigor.

options.label: Plantilla (Kit Wall)
options.lineage: football kit crest and fixture grammar
options.thesis: The group as a squad: crest over the heart, members as a numbered team sheet, seminars as the fixture list.
options.viewport: Crest and name arched over a full-bleed home colourway, squad numbers resolving into the members grid.
options.risk: Sportswear register can read as fan merchandise next to epidemiology.
options.case: Holds product clarity — team sheet and fixtures map exactly onto members and seminars; loses audience identification with peers judging rigor.

options.label: Siete Segmentos
options.thesis: Dates, times and counts in one eight-cell mask, unlit ghost segments designed as carefully as lit ones.
options.viewport: Fixed-slot digit cells stating the next seminar date at totem scale.
options.risk: Digits cannot carry prose; a research group is not a scoreboard.
options.case: Loses both: no register fit for this audience, and member bios cannot exist in a segment mask.
options.kept: Fixed-slot tabular date readouts with ghost cells.

options.label: Asistente 1994
options.thesis: The site as a linear install wizard with beveled chrome, dithered banner and a stepped progress bar.
options.viewport: A bordered dialog with a fixed banner down the left edge and next/back controls.
options.risk: A dated gag; linear gating fights open browsing of members and seminars.
options.case: Loses both: no identification for scientific peers, and the wizard cannot carry free navigation.
options.kept: Block-stepped progress for the seminar trimester.

options.label: The category standard
options.thesis: What every university research group ships: navy hero with photo, three cards, logo strip — executed impeccably.
options.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from every other group page by design.
